title: Keto Canadian Pudding Skewers
description: A keto twist on traditional pudding, served on crunchy skewers. Perfect for a low-carb snack.

ingredients.name: Black Canadian Pudding
ingredients.notes: Make sure to choose a low-carb option

ingredients.name: Crunchy Skewers
ingredients.notes: Made from almond flour or low-carb option

instructions: 1. Cut the black Canadian pudding into 1-inch cubes
2. Melt the garlicky butter in a pan over low heat
3. Add the pudding cubes to the pan and coat with butter
4. Thread the pudding onto the crunchy skewers
